:new: New project intention · #30 ergodic decomposition theorem

A formalization of the ergodic decomposition theorem in its abstract version described in the article "A category-theoretic proof of the ergodic decomposition theorem" by Sean Moss and Paolo Perrone ([1]), in a manner suitable for Mathlib. Then instantiating the abstract version for measure-preserving maps on a probability space.

[1]: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2207.07353

Registered by @lua-vr
Areas: t-dynamics, t-measure-probability
